definitions.gloss: dealer; pusher; illegal seller (especially of drugs)
definitions.explanation: In contemporary Japanese this word almost always refers to someone who sells illegal drugs on the street. It carries strong negative connotations and appears in news reports about drug busts, crime novels, and films. The older general sense of "trader, merchant" has largely faded from everyday use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{売人|ばいにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}した→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧。
examples.english: The police arrested a drug dealer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{麻薬|まやく}→麻薬：18796_mayaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売人|ばいにん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He was known as a drug dealer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{街角|まちかど}→街角：15540_machikado⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧くる{売人|ばいにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかないで→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Absolutely never approach dealers who call out to you on street corners.

notes:
Composed of {売|ばい} (selling) and {〜人|にん} (person). Historically the word meant simply "seller" or "merchant," but in modern usage it is strongly associated with illegal drug dealers. Outside of crime-related contexts, the word can also be used humorously or disparagingly for anyone who pushes a product aggressively, but this extended use always carries a negative undertone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{麻薬|まやく}→麻薬：18796_mayaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売人|ばいにん}: drug dealer
- {覚醒剤|かくせいざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売人|ばいにん}: meth dealer
- {売人|ばいにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧: to arrest a dealer
- {売人|ばいにん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy from a dealer
- {売人|ばいにん}⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧: a dealer ring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{販売員|はんばいいん}→販売員：18939_hanbaiin⟧: sales clerk, salesperson — a neutral word for someone who sells goods at a store
- ⟦{商人|しょうにん}→商人：03236_shounin⟧: merchant, trader — neutral, for legitimate business
- {密売人|みつばいにん}: smuggler, black-market dealer — explicitly criminal, somewhat formal
- ディーラー: dealer (loanword) — neutral for car dealers, but also used for drug dealers in casual speech
